name: org.verifiedhandles/verified-handles
title: Verified Handles
description: Look up people, organisations and things, and their official social media accounts and identifiers.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: One entry, by VHID, short name or Wikidata QID: its public record (title, description, handles, image, URL) and, as `editing`, its current revision, who manages each field and handle (the Wikidata sync or the site), and whether this key may edit it live.

include_platforms.description: Also list the platforms a handle can be on.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Find entries by name (words match titles, subtitles, descriptions), by Wikidata QID (the entries linked to it) or by VHID (it and the entries linking to it).

tools.name: find_by_handle
tools.description: Which public entries list a handle or website: “is this an official account, and whose?”. Give url (a profile’s or a website’s address; a website is matched by its site), or platform and value instead. Empty when none. Not for emails.

url.description: A profile’s or website’s address: https://x.com/someone, example.org.

platform.description: The platform’s catalog id, with value: "twitter" for X; YouTube is "youtube_channel" (a UC… id) or "youtube_handle" (@name, without the @).

tools.name: get_entry_history
tools.description: An entry’s public edit history, newest first.

tools.name: get_entries
tools.description: Up to 50 entries’ public records in one call, by VHID or short name, not a QID (for a QID, get_entry or search_entries). Whole records, very large for a big entry: to find VHIDs by name, use search_entries.

entries.description: Each a VHID or a short name.
